name: vela-calib-band
description: Vela calibration kit: full-screen test pages for measuring text, box model, screen, colour, image and animation behaviour from photos, for any Vela wearable with a device spec (devices/<id>/device.json)

scripts.gen: python3 gen/images.py && node gen/gen.mjs band11 && node gen/gen.mjs band10pro
scripts.test: node --no-warnings test/profile.test.mjs && node --no-warnings test/layout.test.mjs && python3 measure.py selftest
